ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity with a ratio of approximately 95% dark pixels to 5% high-intensity pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity field across both lobes; absence of large-scale contiguous white mottling; focal high-intensity pixel strings are localized to thin linear features in the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch; approximate 65-degree interior angle; depth is approximately 1/6th of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Intense irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; multiple sharp vertical peaks and valleys with varying frequency and amplitude across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trailing edge sweep; lobes extend to sharp, upward-curving distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete circular high-contrast pixel clusters located primarily around the median notch area and the lower margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive linear rake marks; left lobe contains three intersecting diagonal white lines; right lobe contains one primary horizontal line crossing the central lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive tooth-rake scarring visible on both lobes; heavily jagged trailing edge indicating significant prior tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white pixel concentrations along segments of the immediate trailing edge boundary and at the distal lobe tips.
